changelog:
v3.5.6 — libVLC Fallback Player

Major: movies and series that couldn't play before now play inside the app.

• NEW: libVLC secondary backend — when ExoPlayer can't decode a stream (HEVC 10-bit HDR, edge-case H.264 encodes), the app now auto-swaps to libVLC inside the same player fragment without leaving the app. Same controls, same UI, same experience.
• NEW: Early HEVC Main 10 detection on MTK devices — swaps to libVLC in ~3 seconds instead of walking the full recovery ladder.
• NEW: MTK watchdog shortcut — cuts fallback activation from 2+ minutes to ~20 seconds for problem H.264 streams.
• NEW: 'Optimizing playback for this content' transition overlay so users know the app is working.
• NEW: Triple-layer screen-on protection — Fire TV screensaver no longer pops during libVLC playback.
• Fixed: Live TV cursor disappearing after tapping a channel.
• Fixed: Continue Watching now resumes correctly when libVLC takes over — progress is saved and restored regardless of which backend played the content.
• Fixed: Home screen crashes on rapid navigation (hero tap + view destroy race).
• Fixed: Focus navigation crash when genre rows rebuild mid D-pad scroll.
• Fixed: Splash-to-home crash when app backgrounded during intro animation.
